To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structure function variance of quasars is a function of luminosity, restframe wavelength, and the time lag between observations and is similar in the two‐epoch and light curve samples.

the variability structure function of quasars depends on the luminosity and the rest frame wavelength of the observed light and that the variability properties are different for radio selected and X‐ray sources.

the structure function computed for a large sample of quasar light curves is consistent with the structure function derived for a much smaller sample of individual quasars, and that the dependence of structure function on luminosity and rest‐frame wavelength is consistent for these two samples.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the variability properties are the same, but that the variability properties for individual objects are not.
the variability properties are not universal, but they are not very different for different quasars.
the variability properties derived from the SDSS light curves are in qualitative agreement with those derived from the two‐epoch SDSS data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structure function of quasar variability is a function of luminosity, wavelength, time and the type of the quasar.
the variability properties are not the same for different quasars.
quasar light curves can be described as a superposition of a large number of independent stochastic processes with a broad range of time scales.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the variability properties derived from two‐point statistics of a large sample of quasars are similar to those obtained from light curves of individual objects, and thus, two‐point statistics are sufficient to describe the variability of quasars.
the structure function variance of the two‐epoch data and the light curves for individual quasers are very similar and can be used interchangeably.
the structure function computed from two‐epoch data and the one computed from well‐sampled individual light curves are very similar.
